snippet.title: Cyber Assasin // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015120/Cyber_Assasin/

Cyber Assassin is a fast-paced arena shooter where you control a robot annihilating waves of enemies. Survive, upgrade your character after each wave, and become more powerful to dominate the arena!

Developed by
Galactic Geckon

*Note* I know they are missing an S from their title but that is what the stream store says vs their cover image
